Find memories by meaning.

USAGE
  sennit recall [flags] <query>

FLAGS
  --limit n         How many records to return (default 5)
  --tags list       Comma-separated tags the answer is likely to carry; these
                    prefer, never exclude
  --types list      Comma-separated record types that could answer this
  --history         Include versions that have since been superseded
  --from-network    Read bodies from Sia even when this device holds a copy, to
                    check the stored data
  --memory-text     Show each result's full text, its context and its id
  --json            Print the results as JSON

VAULT FLAGS
  --home dir        Vault directory (default ~/.sennit)
  --indexer url     Indexer URL (default https://sia.storage)
  --offline         Work from this device only, without contacting the indexer

OUTPUT FLAGS
  --color when      When to colour output: auto, always or never (default auto)
  --verbose         Show timings, read tiers and other detail

EXAMPLES
  $ sennit recall "how should progress be shown"
  $ sennit recall --tags grant --limit 3 "budget"
  $ sennit recall --memory-text "how should progress be shown"

Flags go before the query.
